steps.title: 识别
steps.desc: 正文里认出 dsh-ui 围栏，不猜其他语言标记

steps.title: 解析
steps.desc: JSON 解析；只做标点级容错

steps.title: 归一化
steps.desc: 别名转规范字段，未知字段只告警不丢整块

steps.title: 挂载
steps.desc: 节点逐个映射成 DOM，动作留在本地

items.title: 两组数字都对得上
items.content: mermaid 里的五组相加正好 60：布局 10、展示 22、图表 3、交互 18、高级 7（choices 与 map 分别计入交互与高级）。

en.title: Sixty node types, four render stages

items.code:
graph TD
    R[dsh-ui fence] --> L[Layout]
    R --> D[Display]

steps.title: Recognize
steps.desc: Find the dsh-ui fence in the reply; no other language tag is guessed

steps.title: Parse
steps.desc: Parse the JSON; only punctuation-level repair

steps.title: Normalize
steps.desc: Aliases become canonical fields; unknown fields warn but never drop the block

steps.title: Mount
steps.desc: Each node maps to the DOM; interaction state stays local

items.title: The two sets of numbers agree
items.content: The five groups in the diagram add up to exactly 60: layout 10, display 22, charts 3, interactive 18, advanced 7 (choices counts as interactive, map as advanced).
